title: Profitable Analytics Software Startup for Sale in Île-de-France, France
tagline: Operating a software and data business at an early commercial stage, built for data centers, AI infrastructure, and energy-related decision workflows. The acquisition opportunity centres on the existing product, curated datasets, methodology, and operating processes. - Coverage reviewed this month: 6,632 published, publicly verified, non-demo data center supply records across 169 countries, with 94,398 MW of sourced IT capacity. IT MW includes pipeline and must not be interpreted as operating or available capacity. - The energy layer contains 109,768 generation records across 160 countries, plus 126,706 mapped substation records and 704,781 line segments across 159 countries. Generation records are not unique physical plants. Network records do not establish grid headroom. - Source references, verification dates, capacity definitions and development stages form part of the research workflow. Coverage depth varies by market, and underlying data licences and transfer rights require diligence. - Revenue model: professional and team subscriptions, enterprise packages and commissioned research. Scoped data delivery is an additional development opportunity. Existing distribution channels could support cross-selling and expansion, subject to customer demand and delivery economics. - Commercial evidence reviewed for this listing includes a EUR 790 invoice excluding VAT for one month. Customer-reported payment remains subject to bank reconciliation in that record. The platform-generated EUR 9,480 annual run rate is a mechanical annualisation, not established contracted ARR or proven annual revenue. - The displayed 30-40% EBITDA range is indicative, not reconciled annual profitability. The reference period, complete cost base, and founder replacement cost must be verified. Earlier financial estimates in dated attachments are unverified and should not be treated as current annual performance. - Founder-led operations with sector knowledge in data center development, power, and project qualification. A founder-supported transition can be agreed. Founder credentials, a product overview, and dated supporting materials are available to introduced members. - EUR 5 million asking price for the software and data business. The strategic acquisition rationale concerns transferable assets and buyer-specific distribution opportunities; current revenue alone does not substantiate that asking price.
